citations.quote: I accepted the design researcher role at Northstar Studio. For now, I want to deepen my work in service design. I do my best focused work remotely.
This month I feel exhausted after the launch. My goal has shifted: I want to improve public-service research.
I need to correct the start date. I began on 2026-01-12, not 2026-02-04. My current goal is still to improve public-service research.
Remote work has suited me throughout the year. I might move to Valencia someday, but I have made no plan. The deadline may be 2026-12-07, though I need to confirm it.
Our onboarding sheet records Mateo's start date as 2026-02-04.
